original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook deploying a Java application as a systemd service: installs OpenJDK 21, creates a service user, copies the application JAR, writes the systemd unit file, and starts the service. Idempotent across re-runs.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook deploying a Java application as a systemd service: installs OpenJDK 21, creates a service user, copies the application JAR, writes the systemd unit file, and starts the service. Idempotent across re-runs.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Deploy Java application as systemd service
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    app_name: myapp
    app_user: myapp
    app_group: myapp
    jar_source: ./myapp.jar
    jar_dest: /opt/{{ app_name }}/{{ app_name }}.jar
    java_opts: "-Xms512m -Xmx2g"
  tasks:
    - name: Install OpenJDK 21
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: openjdk-21-jdk
        state: present
        update_cache: true

    - name: Create service group
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ app_group }}"
        system: true

    - name: Create service user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        home: /opt/{{ app_name }}
        create_home: false

    - name: Ensure application directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /opt/{{ app_name }}
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        mode: "0750"

    - name: Copy application JAR
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ jar_source }}"
        dest: "{{ jar_dest }}"
        owner: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        mode: "0640"
      notify: Restart application

    - name: Deploy systemd unit file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/{{ app_name }}.service
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description={{ app_name }} Java Application
          After=network.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User={{ app_user }}
          Group={{ app_group }}
          ExecStart=/usr/bin/java {{ java_opts }} -jar {{ jar_dest }}
          SuccessExitStatus=143
          Restart=always
          RestartSec=10
          NoNewPrivileges=true
          PrivateTmp=true

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
      notify: Reload systemd and start application

    - name: Enable and start service
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ app_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started
        daemon_reload: true

  handlers:
    - name: Restart application
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ app_name }}"
        state: restarted

    - name: Reload systemd and start application
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: "{{ app_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started
        daemon_reload: true
